raw.rationale: Pralatrexate is a potent antifolate with high affinity for the reduced folate carrier (RFC1/SLC19A1), and its approved activity in peripheral T-cell lymphoma reflects lineage-selective uptake; PRISM single-dose data show selective sensitivity in lymphoma/leukemia lines but among the listed solid-tumor lineages selectivity is rare, with only modest enrichment possible in folate-transporter-high lineages such as some lung and breast lines.
